title: WhatsApp message when a row is added in Xenibase
summary: When a new row is added to a table in your Xenibase database (an order, a booking, a sign-up), send the phone number in it your approved WhatsApp template.
description: Taskiem asks Xenibase for the table's changes itself when you publish, and stops them if you take the workflow down. Each committed insert into the table sends your approved WhatsApp template to the number in the phone column, with the value of the name column as its first body variable. A rolled-back insert sends nothing, and Xenibase delivering the same insert twice sends one message. Create and get the template approved in WhatsApp Manager first.

params.name: phone_column
params.title: Phone column
params.description: The column holding the number to message.

params.name: name_column
params.title: Name column
params.description: The column with the person's name.

params.name: template_name
params.title: WhatsApp template
params.description: Your approved template, chosen by what it says. Its words take the person's name.

params.name: language
params.title: Template language
params.description: Filled in when you choose the template.

params.name: xenibase_connection
params.title: Xenibase connection
params.description: The Xenibase connection (an API token restricted to the project) whose table is watched.

params.name: whatsapp_connection
params.title: WhatsApp connection
params.description: The name of your WhatsApp Business connection.

definition.name: WhatsApp message when a row is added in Xenibase

steps.name: Send the WhatsApp template to the number in the new row
steps.when: =has(trigger.body.record) && trigger.body.record != null && steps.settings.output.phone in trigger.body.record && trigger.body.record[steps.settings.output.phone] != null && string(trigger.body.record[steps.settings.output.phone]) != ''
